mentions.name: Category-based Fantasy Football league format
mentions.description: A new category-based Fantasy Football league format, inspired by how hockey and baseball fantasy leagues work, designed to make games more watchable. It incorporates defense, which traditional fantasy football ignores, and rebalances the value of positions like running back and tight end to better reflect real-world relevance.
mentions.problem: Traditional Fantasy Football ignores half the game (defense) and elevates economically less valuable positions like RB and TE far past their real-world relevance.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working a new Fantasy Football league/format that is category-based (like hockey/baseball) in an attempt to make games more "watchable". The problem with traditional Fantasy Football, is that half of the game (defence) is ignored, while not very economically-valuable positions, like RB and TE, are elevated far past their real world relevance.
